def solve3(k):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); ho=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
    bg=collections.Counter(gi.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=gi.copy()
    for comp in comps_by_color(gi,bg):
        p=[(y-min(x[0] for x in comp),x-min(x[1] for x in comp),int(gi[y,x])) for y,x in comp]
        om=-1; templ=None
        for oc in comps_all(ho,bg):
            inter=sum(1 for a in p if a in set(map(tuple,norm(oc,ho))))
            if inter>om: om=inter; templ=set(map(tuple,norm(oc,ho)))
        if om==len(p): continue
        cands=[]
        for fr,fc,v in p:
            for (tr,tc,vv) in templ:
                if vv!=v: continue
                oy,ox=tr-fr,tc-fc
                i2=sum(1 for q in p if ((q[0]+oy,q[1]+ox),(q[2])) in templ)
                cands.append((i2,oy,ox))
        if not cands: continue
        # prefer fully consistent placement
        full=[c for c in cands if sum(1 for q in p if ((q[0]+c[1],q[1]+c[2]),q[2]) in templ)==len(p)]
        if full:
            full.sort(reverse=True)
            oy,ox=full[0][1:]
        else:
            cands.sort(key=lambda c:(-c[0],c[1],c[2]))
            oy,ox=cands[0][1:]
        tcells=[(yy+oy,xx+ox,int(ho[yy+oy,xx+ox])) for yy,xx,_ in templ]
        for y,x,v in tcells:
            if 0<=y<gi.shape[0] and 0<=x<gi.shape[1] and gi[y,x]==bg:
                out[y,x]=v
    return out

def solve5(k):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); ho=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
    bg=collections.Counter(gi.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=gi.copy()
    frags=[c for c in comps_by_color(gi,bg)]
    def comp_order(): return sorted(frags,key=lambda c:(min(y for y,x in c),min(x for y,x in c)))
    for comp in comp_order():
        p=[(y-min(x[0] for x in comp),x-min(x[1] for x in comp),int(gi[y,x])) for y,x in comp]
        om=-1; templ=None
        for oc in comps_all(out,out if False else np.array([[9]] if False else [0])):
            pass
        # templates derived from CURRENT out: multi-comp connected on non-bg
        bestt=None
        for oc in comps_all(out,gi.flat[0]):
            pass
        # redo: template library = out's own comps recomputed including our updates
        tmpl=[]
        for oc in comps_all(out,bg):
            mr=min(y for y,x in oc); mc=min(x for y,x in oc)
            tnorm=tuple(sorted((y-mr,x-mc,int(out[y,x])) for y,x in oc))
            inter=sum(1 for a in p if a in set(map(tuple,tnorm)))
            if inter>om: om=inter; templ=set(map(tuple,tnorm)); bestt=tnorm
        if om==len(p): continue
        cands=[]
        for fr,fc,v in p:
            for (tr,tc,vv) in bestt:
                if vv!=v: continue
                oy,ox=tr-fr,tc-fc
                i2=sum(1 for q in p if ((q[0]+oy,q[1]+ox),(q[2])) in bestt)
                cands.append((i2,oy,ox))
        if not cands: continue
        fc=[c for c in cands if sum(1 for q in p if ((q[0]+c[1],q[1]+c[2]),q[2]) in bestt)==len(p)]
        sc=lambda c:(sum(1 for yy,xx,_ in [(tt[0],tt[1],tt[2]) for tt in bestt] if 0<=yy+c[1]<gi.shape[0] and 0<=xx+c[2]<gi.shape[1] and out[yy+c[1],xx+c[2]]==bg),c[1],c[2])
        if fc: fc.sort(key=sc); oy,ox=fc[0][1:]
        else: cands.sort(key=sc); oy,ox=cands[0][1:]
        for yy,xx,v in [(tt[0]+oy,tt[1]+ox,tt[2]) for tt in bestt]:
            if 0<=yy<gi.shape[0] and 0<=xx<gi.shape[1] and out[yy,xx]==bg:
                out[yy,xx]=v
    return out

def solve(k):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); ho=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
    bg=collections.Counter(gi.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    tl=[]  # template library: all output comps
    for oc in comps_multi(ho,bg):
        mr=min(y for y,x in oc); mc=min(x for y,x in oc)
        tnorm=tuple(sorted((y-mr,x-mc,int(ho[y,x])) for y,x in oc))
        tl.append(tnorm)
    # templates that are NOT present in the input (only use truly new ones)
    ti=set()
    for c in comps_by_color(gi,bg):
        mr=min(y for y,x in c); mc=min(x for y,x in c)
        s=tuple(sorted((y-mr,x-mc,int(gi[y,x])) for y,x in c))
        ti.add(s)
    tl=[t for t in tl if t not in ti]
    out=gi.copy()
    for comp in comps_by_color(gi,bg):
        p=[(y-min(x[0] for x in comp),x-min(x[1] for x in comp),int(gi[y,x])) for y,x in comp]
        om=-1; templ=None
        for t in tl:
            inter=sum(1 for a in p if a in set(t))
            if inter>om: om=inter; templ=set(t)
        if om==len(p): continue
        cands=[]
        for fr,fc,v in p:
            for tr,tc_,tv in templ:
                if tv!=v: continue
                oy,ox=tr-fr,tc_-fc
                nmatch=sum(1 for q in p if (q[0]+oy,q[1]+ox) in templ and int(ho[q[0]+oy,q[1]+ox])==q[2])
                cands.append((nmatch,len(p)-nmatch,-oy,-ox,oy,ox))
        if not cands: continue
        full=[c for c in cands if sum(1 for q in p if (q[0]+c[4],q[1]+c[5]) in templ)==len(p)]
        fcfull = full if full else []
        if fcfull:
            best=max(fcfull,key=lambda c:c[0])
            oy,ox=best[4],best[5]
        else:
            cands.sort(key=lambda c:(c[0],c[1],c[2],c[3]))
            _,_,_,_,oy,ox=cands[0]
        for yy,xx,v in [(tt[0]+oy,tt[1]+ox,tt[2]) for tt in templ]:
            if 0<=yy<gi.shape[0] and 0<=xx<gi.shape[1] and gi[yy,xx]==bg:
                out[yy,xx]=v
    return out

    ti=set()
    for c in comps_all(gi,bg):

            ti.add(tuple(sorted((y-mr,x-mc,int(gi[y,x])) for y,x in c)))

    out=gi.copy()
    for comp in comps_all(gi,bg):
        p=[(y-min(x[0] for x in comp),x-min(x[1] for x in comp),int(gi[y,x])) for y,x in comp]

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def solve3(i):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); ho=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    H_,W_=gi.shape
    bgi=collections.Counter(gi.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    tshapes=comps_of(ho,bgi)
    out=gi.copy()
    for comp in comps_of(gi,bgi):
        if len(comp)==1: continue
        mr=min(p[0] for p in comp); mc=min(p[1] for p in comp)
        rel=frozenset((p[0]-mr,p[1]-mc,p[2]) for p in comp)
        cand=[]
        for t in tshapes:
            S=set(t)
            for dy in range(-H_,H_+1):
                for dx in range(-W_,W_+1):
                    if all(((a+dy,b+dx) in S and int(t[a+dy,b+dx])==vv) for a,b,vv in rel):
                        O=(mr-dy,mc-dx)
                        ov=sum(1 for pa,pb,vv in t if 0<=O[0]+pa<H_ and 0<=O[1]+pb<W_ and gi[O[0]+pa,O[1]+pb]!=bgi)
                        nc=sum(1 for pa,pb,vv in t if 0<=O[0]+pa<H_ and 0<=O[1]+pb<W_ and gi[O[0]+pa,O[1]+pb]==bgi)
                        # prefer most overlap with non-bg, tie-break fewest new paint, then largest template
                        cand.append((-ov,-nc,len(t),O,t))
        if not cand: continue
        _,_,_,O,t=cand[0]
        for pa,pb,vv in t:
            rr,cc=O[0]+pa,O[1]+pb
            if 0<=rr<H_ and 0<=cc<W_ and gi[rr,cc]==bgi: out[rr,cc]=vv
    return out

import numpy as np, collections
# Hypothesis: pick candidate offset maximizing agreement = minimize conflicts between placements; also must reproduce exact output. Verify which alignment rule reproduces demos exactly.
def candidates(frag,T):
    fcells={p:int(gi[p]) for p in frag}
    out=[]
    for p1,v1 in fcells.items():
        for p2,tv in T.items():
            if tv!=v1: continue
            dr=p2[0]-p1[0]; dc=p2[1]-p1[1]
            bad=sum(1 for (pa,pb),tv in T.items() if not(0<=pa+dr<H and 0<=pb+dc<W_) or (gi[pa+dr,pb+dc]!=tv and gi[pa+dr,pb+dc] not in set(fcells.values())))
            good=len(T)-bad-len(fcells)
            out.append((-bad,good,T,dr,dc))
    return out
def check(i,mode):
    gi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); ho=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    bgi=collections.Counter(gi.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H_,W_=gi.shape
    tmpl=[{p:int(ho[p]) for p in cc} for cc in compabs(ho,bgi) if len(set(int(ho[p]) for p in cc))>=2]
